The Leapleech is a member of the parasites focused on sending out a swarm of dangerous infectious leeches. As members of other troupes attack them, they will grow more and more powerful.
Upon death, their body will writhe and burst, exploding into a swarm of leapleeches based how many people attacked them during their life. These leeches are hostile towards all non-parasites, and will hunt people down and jump at them. When they jump on someone, they will convert them into a leapleech as well, but they can be countered by being killed or left in hazardous conditions.
